regions.name: startup
regions.evidence: French startup clears BSS, sets stack and GP, dispatches constructors and calls Main_Init. The entire interval is byte-identical at the same addresses to the independently classified Spanish CRT.

regions.name: game
regions.evidence: Exact linked French C starts at Main_Init and ends this interval with the complete model_slot_queries group. All intervening bytes are covered by exact C or individually byte-verified handwritten functions.

regions.name: embedded-sdk-getter
regions.evidence: The complete sixteen-byte getter is identical to the classified Spanish SDK getter at the same address, between independently matched model_slot_queries and model_slot_support groups.

regions.name: game-after-sdk-getter
regions.evidence: Exact French model_slot_support begins this interval; the complete ai_script_state_ops group ends at 0x80073C4C. All intervening bytes are covered by exact C or individually byte-verified handwritten functions.

regions.name: sdk
regions.evidence: The entire French interval is byte-identical to the independently classified Spanish SN/Psy-Q host-I/O, runtime, hardware, GTE, libc, memory-card, CD, GPU, SPU and MDEC library region. Provisional internal disassembler boundaries do not change its ownership.
